# Youcef Bounabi

> Full-Spectrum Software Engineer, High-End Web Architect & AI Automation Specialist.

## About
Youcef Bounabi is a software engineer specializing in high-performance bespoke websites, custom enterprise web applications (ERPs, CRMs, client portals), and autonomous AI automation systems.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Weapons
1. **High-End Websites**: Bespoke Next.js/React architectures, 60fps micro-animations, 3D visual experiences (Three.js/R3F), and Core Web Vitals optimization.
2. **Custom Enterprise Systems & Applications**: Tailored business tools, ERPs, CRMs, inventory systems, and operational software that eliminate paper and spreadsheet chaos.
3. **Omnichannel AI Automation**: Conversational chat agents on Instagram, WhatsApp, and Web supporting Algerian Darija, French, Arabizi, and English with auto-export to shipping couriers (Yalidine).
4. **AI Voice Telephony**: 24/7 inbound phone receptionists for clinics and firms in the UK, Europe, and MENA markets.
